notes: Models are routed through OpenRouter; these are not direct-provider API connections.
Claude Fable, Gemini Pro and Grok use OpenRouter rolling latest aliases; they may resolve to newer releases over time.
GPT-6.2 Astra and Qwen4 Max are pinned to the current flagship text models listed in OpenRouter on 2026-11-21.
Model availability and pricing change; confirm them in OpenRouter before live runs.
The hierarchy is one lead draft, seven independent reviews, one discussion turn from the lead and each reviewer, then a final plan synthesis.
Every model receives the complete repository capability registry in its prompt.
Capability profiles describe intended review strengths; they do not grant API tools or guarantee performance.
A default run makes seventeen model requests: one lead draft, seven reviews, eight discussion turns and final plan synthesis.
On credit or other model-call failure, the run pauses; it never advances to a final plan with missing contributions.
